claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Ethambutol is a mycobacterial arabinosyltransferase inhibitor with no activity against human cells; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a human cancer cell line panel.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: Ethambutol is a mycobacterial arabinosyltransferase inhibitor with no activity against human cells; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a human cancer cell line panel.
